info.bio: Commander Vance leads from the front. Vanguard training turns the Commander into the toughest unit on the field.
info.style: Put the Commander in the fight. Your hero tanks, kills and holds ground while your army catches up.
weaknesses: Losing the Commander costs you tempo

command: Lead early pushes with the Commander, then Rally Cry when the squads arrive.
Save Mech Drop for a Hive assault or to break a big attack wave.
classic: Your blaster is a real tower. Park the Commander on the busiest lane.
Tesla Coil pairs well with Cryo: slowed aliens let it chain 2 more jumps (Conduct).
siege: Commander Training in the Tech Lab stacks with Vanguard for a very tanky hero.
Hero augments and relics get extra value from your bigger base stats.

engineer.name: Engineer
engineer.desc: Towers cost 10% less, repairs are twice as fast

info.bio: An expert in prefab fortifications. Engineers get more buildings and towers for the same Supplies.
info.style: Build wide and turtle up. Cheaper buildings mean faster tech, more expansions and stronger defenses.
strengths: Turret Drop is a cheap, flexible power
weaknesses: Slower to win if you only defend

command: Expand early. The 15% discount applies to expansion bases too.
Turret Drop can hold a relay or a forward position while your army is away.
classic: Repairs are twice as fast, so damaged towers come back quickly between waves.
Your 10% discount applies to every tower, so build early and often.
siege: Trade Network plus the Engineer discount makes Depots and towers very cheap.
Tower blueprints are worth more to you. Take them when they're offered.

info.bio: A strategist with priority access to orbital support. Tacticians fight with powers more than troops.
info.style: Spend Supplies on powers. Orbital Strike, Cryo Bomb and Carpet Bombing come back fast and hit hard.
strengths: All powers recharge 35% faster and hit 25% harder
weaknesses: Powers cost Supplies, so the army can fall behind

command: Stand units on relays: they speed up power recharge even more.
Carpet Bombing fires from your nearest base toward the target. Aim it along the enemy's path.
classic: Fire Orbital Strike on every wave. With the shorter cooldown it's ready again before the next one.
Radar Relay helps your towers spot cloaked aliens.
siege: Orbital Priority in the Tech Lab stacks with your cooldown bonus.
Pick cards that boost powers. Power damage gets around strain HP bonuses.

ignis.name: Ignis
ignis.desc: Pyro: Flamer and Acid Spitter +35% damage, burns +40%, Mortar +20% damage

info.bio: Ignis burns whatever the swarm sends. Everything she brings leaves the ground on fire.
info.style: Flamers and fire. Melt infantry swarms and alien buildings, and keep everything burning.

command: Bring Missile Trucks or Marines to cover the air units your Flamers can't hit.
Firestorm on a Hive's choke point makes its waves burn on the way out.
classic: Flamer, Acid Spitter and Mortar are all boosted. Mortar shells hit burning aliens 1.5x harder (Detonate).
Flamers set Tar Pits ablaze, which makes a strong combo.
siege: If the swarm adapts to fire, mix in towers or tanks for a while.
Burn and damage-over-time cards scale well with your bonuses.

rime.name: Rime
rime.desc: Cryo: Cryo slow +10%, slowed aliens take +25% damage, +20% Commander HP

info.bio: Rime freezes the battlefield. Slowed aliens become easy targets for everything else.
info.style: Slow, freeze, shatter. Lock enemies in place so your army and towers can finish them.
strengths: Deep Freeze stops a whole attack
weaknesses: Needs damage dealers to finish what it freezes

command: Cryo Bomb first, then Orbital Strike. The +25% applies to power damage too.
Deep Freeze is the best panic button in the game against a base rush.
classic: Cryo plus Railgun gives Shatter: Railguns deal 2x to slowed aliens.
Cryo also enables Conduct: Tesla chains 2 more jumps through slowed aliens.
siege: Slow-based cards are worth more to you because of the damage bonus.
Watch for strains that resist slows. Swap to damage if they show up.

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.desc: Defender: towers +50% HP, Core repairs 2 HP a wave, takes 30% less damage

info.bio: Bastion has never lost a base. Bastion buildings are built to stand up to a full Hive assault.
info.style: Make your bases and towers hard to kill, then win the long game.
strengths: Bulwark shields every building at once
weaknesses: Can be slow to finish maps

command: Bunkers and towers at expansions hold much longer. Expand aggressively.
Use Bulwark right before a big wave hits, not after.
classic: Build towers where aliens bunch up. Your sturdier towers can take the hits while others deal the damage.
Shield Projectors and Barricades buy your towers even more time.
siege: Defense battles and boss fights against the Heart are your strongest nodes.
Hardened Kit and Turret Engineering stack with your building HP.

kestrel.name: Kestrel
kestrel.desc: Swarm: Drone Bays +1 drone and +25% damage, Mine Layers +2 mines, Sonic +20%

info.bio: Kestrel flew drone wings before she took command. Her forces rule the sky.
info.style: Build air. Hornets and Gunships are cheaper and hit harder, and Drone Swarm adds extra firepower.
strengths: Drone Swarm is free extra damage

command: Hornets crush vehicles and alien heavies. Watch out for alien anti-air.
Mobile air armies are great for raids. Hit the Hive's expansions.
classic: Drone Bays and Mine Layers cover the ground while your Commander fights in another lane.
Sonic Disruptors are boosted too, which helps against big ground waves.
siege: If the swarm adapts to air, add a ground squad until it adapts back.
Air-unit cards and unlocks are worth more for you.

ledger.name: Ledger
ledger.desc: Economist: +120 start Energy, +12 a wave, upgrades -15%, but blaster -40%

info.bio: Ledger runs the Omega supply chain. Ledger forces get extra resources but a weaker Commander.
info.style: Out-produce the swarm. Start with more Supplies, earn more and turn it into a bigger army.
weaknesses: Needs good macro to pay off

command: Use the starting Supplies for a fast second base.
Supply Drop costs nothing. Use it on cooldown.
classic: Your blaster is weak, so let towers do the killing and spend the extra Energy early.
Harvesters and Bio-Labs push your income even higher.
siege: Logistics Corps in the Tech Lab stacks with your starting Supplies.
Spend Scrap aggressively at Depots. Your economy makes up for it in battle.

hawk.name: Hawk
hawk.desc: Sniper: Railgun and Laser +25% damage and +15% range, 10% tower crits

info.bio: Hawk sees everything and misses nothing. Sniper doctrine kills the biggest threats first.
info.style: Out-range the swarm. Rockets and Siege Tanks hit from further away, and Sniper Network deletes heavies.
strengths: Rocket Troopers and Siege Tanks +20% range and damage
Sniper Network kills the toughest targets
weaknesses: Needs a frontline to protect the back line

command: Put Marines or a Mantis in front and Tanks and Rockets behind.
Sniper Network picks the 6 toughest visible aliens. Use it on bosses and heavies.
classic: Build Railguns and Lasers at the back of long lanes. The extra range lets them fire for longer.
Mirror Arrays bounce Railgun shots around corners.
siege: Range is very strong against Siege Run bosses that hit hard up close.
If the swarm adapts to tanks, mix in air.
